text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 28 · 樱桃奶昔餐吧.
Environment:  A whimsical empty Barbie-inspired 1950s milkshake diner with blush-pink shell booths, ivory rounded counter, pale mint stools, creamy checkerboard tiles and a single cherry milkshake on the counter. Large daylight window with soft palms outside. No menu writing, faces, logos or waitresses; original cinematic set, toy-like joyful shapes with real tactile surfaces.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 28 · 樱桃奶昔餐吧
